the synthesis, crystal structures, and the photo-catalytic activity of three one-dimensional Cu(ii)-based coordination polymers.
the synthesis, structural characterization, and the photo-degradation studies of three Cu(ii) coordination complexes.
the synthesis of a new series of Cu(ii) coordination polymer photo-catalysts and the investigation of the influence of different coordination sites on the photo-catalytic activities.

the coordination environment of metal ions plays a significant role in catalytic activities.
the photo-catalytic activity of the synthesized complexes depends upon the nature of the ligand, the number of coordinated water molecules, the nature of the bridging ligands and the metal ions.

the coordination environments of metal centers have a significant influence on the photo-catalytic activities.
the photo-catalytic activity of a Cu(ii) complex is highly dependent upon the nature of the coordinated water molecules in the complex.
